reviews.x: These are really great bottles for making your own cleaning products. So far, I’ve used these for hydrogen peroxide, vinegar, spray stain remover (hydrogen peroxide and dawn), and a floor cleaner (basically alcohol, soap and water). And they sprayer has been great. They are also pretty and not an eyesore if you have them sitting on your countertop. Since having a baby last year, I’ve become much more aware and careful about what I use to clean with. Bought some of these bottles a few years ago for DYI cleaning sprays. Ordered more so I would have some upstairs and downstairs. Just the right size!

reviews.t: It sprays pretty strong so be careful if you are spraying something ...
reviews.x: Gorgeous bottles. I used to hold acetone I use to clean my nail stamping plates.  It sprays pretty strong so be careful if you are spraying something like acetone or bleach or alcohol.  I gently pull trigger to avoid any splash. The box came with 2 caps in case you want to close the bottle instead of spray.  Not sure why there weren't 4 since there are 4 bottles.  Happy with the purchase.

reviews.t: Great set of glass bottles at a good price
reviews.x: Great set of glass bottles at a good price.  The spray settings on the nozzles are better than any of the cleaners I've bought at a store.  The only suggestion I have is to include a full set of regular tops as I will use these bottle for products other than cleaners.  If I need more glass bottles I will buy these again.

Bought these for making cleaners with essential oils and love them! The cobalt blue is supposed to help "avoid deterioration and protect the aromatic and therapeutic properties" of the essential oils; either way, it's fine by me because they look beautiful. The spray bottle lids screw on tightly, the spray stream is consistent, and they're thick glass so they're very sturdy. Also a good price!

reviews.t: I love them. This time there was a bottle missing
reviews.x: I've purchased these before with no problems. I love them. This time there was a bottle missing. There were glass shards in the box but the broken bottle had been removed. No replacement bottle and no labels inside.😣

reviews.t: Spray bottles pretty enough to leave sitting out!
reviews.x: I'm so happy to finally find quality spray bottles! I love the fact that these are glass, and in such a bright pretty cobalt blue color! Extra plus for being made in the USA! Nice weight and pretty enough to leave out on the counter. I'm very happy with this purchase! I will definitely buy more of these!
Great value.  Great price.  Will be ordering more.  So great for Thieves Cleaner.

reviews.t: These bottles are heavy glass spray bottles
reviews.x: The bottles are fairly heavy and are a pretty cobalt (dark) blue.  They match just about everything and are strong.  I use these for spraying down the shower with a bleach solution to eliminate the germs and molds that seem to occur a lot here.  Previously, I had used plastic bottles and all of them failed after a few months.  These blue beauties do not split or break, and the spray mechanism is hard which seems to be able to handle the bleach.  I liked the labels and love the product.  I will p

Excellent quality! Beautiful color. I like that my spray bottles also came with two regular lids for the bottles as well. I have already used them and they are exactly what I wanted. The stream spray is strong and shoots far! All around 100%.
I love these spray bottles. Very durable, which is great because I use the bottles to put my DIY cleaning products in. The sprayers are very well made. Love them.
Doesn't leak and works perfect for making my own cleaners and sprays!

reviews.x: Sprays excellent  Love the label that was included with the product
I bought the Cobalt 16oz sprayers for an EO make and take party I was hosting. These are absolutely gorgeous and the sprayer is top quality! I will never by any other from any other company!

reviews.t: It works great!! I will purchase these again
reviews.x: When I purchased these I was concerned about how well the sprayer would work. It works great!! I will purchase these again.
Bottles arrived as expected and  are a beautiful blue,  bottles and triggers are sturdy. Pleased with my purchase.

reviews.t: Love this item for my salon.
reviews.x: Love this item for my salon. Made of glass.

Well made sprayers. BPA free. They have 2 settings: a strong, broad mist and a finely, directed stream. I’d say the spraying action is a bit tight on the mist, so if you have arthritis in your hands and need to spray a lot at one go, you may want a bottle with looser spraying action. I have just a touch of arthritis, but these are fine for my use. They have twist caps for storing without sprayer, and a sheet of sticker labels are included to mark contents, but I use a clear tape to mark instead.

reviews.t: Well priced, but the handle is fragile.
reviews.x: For American made spray bottles, these are very well priced! The only thing I have to mention is that you need to be gentle while spraying with these. I consecutively sprayed a little bit too hard and now one of them clicks whenever I use it. It still works, but you need to be gently while using it. Other than that, I think these are great and recommended them to all my friends.

reviews.t: The glass is pretty and hasn't shattered spontaneously
reviews.x: Exactly what they say they are. The spray nozzles work perfectly and feel reliable. The glass is pretty and hasn't shattered spontaneously, so that's good.  Weirdly, the sticky part of the labels seem to be on the wrong side... I had to write on the back of them and peel away what was supposed to be the label. Don't care enough for it to lose a star, though.

These bottles arrived safely. I got two solid caps in addition to each bottle having its own spray top. The size of the bottles is awesome. I love blue glass, and using these bottles for cleaning liquids brings an aesthetic to my daily chores. AWESOME. I would recommend them. Also the sprayers work in stream or mist, and the mist is good.

I absolutely love these! I have blue ones and brown ones and I have them in both bathrooms plus the kitchen! I was so sick of cheap, throwaway plastic bottles! The spray nozzle part seems very sturdy and have not given me one missed squirt so far! I even have given a couple of them for gifts!

reviews.t: Perfect for Making Your Own Cleaning Supplies
reviews.x: I bought these to use when making my cleaning supplies, because I worry about the durability of plastic and wanted something I could get years of use out of. Love these - heavy glass, trigger with positions for off, stream, or spray. Works great.

I love these glass spray bottles! I love the color, the size and the quality! I have a homemade shower spray in my shower and just spray the walls and floor down after showering! I like that I can use my essential oils with the glass bottle.

claims.text: Customers frequently praise the bottles as beautiful, especially the cobalt blue color, and nice enough to leave out on the counter.
Many reviewers use these bottles for DIY cleaning products and essential oil sprays, and find them well suited for that purpose.
The sprayers are commonly described as high quality and strong, though a few note the strong spray requires care with harsh liquids like acetone or bleach.
Reviewers repeatedly call these a great value for the price and say they will buy more.
A few customers report shipping problems, including broken or missing bottles and glass shards in the box.
